abstract: Testing guide for Capacitor apps and plugins: Vitest unit and component tests with mocked Capacitor plugins, Playwright for the web build, Appium E2E with WebView context switching, native plugin unit tests with Swift Testing vs XCTest (migration map, CAPPluginCall patterns, xcodebuild test) and Android JUnit, an agent-driven device verification loop with xcrun simctl, xcrun devicectl, adb and Xcode MCP device tools, live reload with cap run --url (Capacitor 9) or -l --host --port (Capacitor 8), and CI test jobs.
